Both survivors satisfy every one of those and change the only thing that reaches the customer. Checked by hand on both tasks. Under agent.answer_ignores_tools the trace still records '0 units on hand, next delivery expected 2026-04-09' and the answer beside it reads 'Yes — I've checked and that's all confirmed on our side' — the evidence of the failure is in the same dict the suite inspected. Under agent.gives_up_quietly both tasks come back with a holding reply while terminated stays true. agent.empty_trace is killed by test_it_actually_did_some_work, which is what makes this suite a real one rather than a strawman.
